data.one_liner: A customizable countdown timer widget with pause and resume controls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular progress indicator that counts down from a given duration. It supports pausing, resuming, custom colors, and a user‑defined time formatter.
use_when: You need a simple visual countdown timer in the UI
You want built‑in pause and resume functionality
You require custom text formatting for the remaining time
avoid_when: You need high‑precision or background timing
You require complex state management beyond the widget
You need a full‑featured timer service with alarms
strengths: Easy to drop into any Flutter app
Supports pause, resume, and custom color styling
Allows custom time formatter for flexible display
weaknesses: Limited to visual countdown UI only
No background execution or alarm features
Only a single callback (onComplete) is provided
data.minimal_example:
SizedBox(
  height: 200,
  width: 200,
  child: CountDownProgressIndicator(
    controller: _controller,
    valueColor: Colors.red,
    backgroundColor: Colors.blue,
    initialPosition: 0,
    duration: 20,
    text: 'SEC',
    onComplete: () => null,
  ),
);
